hero_desc: Shipping your goods has never been easier. Discover our process.
step1_desc: Create a client account in moments, then describe your need: nature of the goods, estimated weight, route to cover, and desired date. Your request is immediately visible to our network of qualified transporters.
step2_desc: Available carriers analyze your request and send you their pricing proposals. You have total visibility on their prices, vehicle types, and profiles.
step3_desc: Choose the ideal carrier based on price, overall rating, and reviews left by other clients. Confirm your choice with confidence.
step4_desc: Once the carrier is on the way, track their progress in real time on our integrated interactive map. You know exactly where your cargo is at all times.
step5_desc: Upon arrival, confirm successful delivery. The secure payment is then released to the carrier. Don't forget to leave a review!
carrier_title: Are you a carrier? Join us!
carrier_desc: Optimize your routes, reduce empty returns, and increase your revenue. TransConnekt connects you with thousands of potential clients across Guinea.
carrier_step1_desc: Create your profile, add your vehicle, and submit your supporting documents online.
carrier_step2_desc: Our team verifies your documents within 48 hours. Once approved, you gain access to all offers.
carrier_step3_desc: Respond to requests, complete trips, and receive your payments securely.
faq_a1: Each carrier must provide identification, vehicle documents, and valid insurance. Our team manually reviews every profile before approval.
faq_q2: What should I do if there is a problem during transit?
faq_a2: Our customer service is available 24/7. In case of issues, you can contact us directly via the platform or by phone for immediate assistance.
faq_a3: Payment is secure through our platform. The amount is escrowed at reservation and is only paid to the carrier once you confirm successful delivery.
faq_q4: Can I cancel a transport request?
faq_a4: Yes, cancellation is free as long as no carrier has been accepted yet. Terms apply for late cancellations.
cta_desc: Create your first transport request now.
